id: W-R59 independent validation of unseen synthetic xorshift across all supported amplitudes
protocol: Pinned W-R58 method; fresh seed populations, exact source-heldout ridge and paired-choice scoring
criterion: SOURCE_SPECIFIC_REPLICATION if xorshift >=0.65 in all 9 amplitude/development pairs and NOT general source transfer unless >=2/3 families pass each pair. PARTIAL if all xorshift >=0.55; otherwise negative.
safety: No previously used heldout or FORGE-owned seed ranges, no post-result optimization, single archived original first use, full Go regression, draft without scientific promotion.
